shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Oni Spacewar carrier Revision 3 asset. suffix: Requested canvas WIDTH x HEIGHT pixels. Whole asset contained; objects have clear transparent margin.
console_prompt: Whole south-facing Command Console sprite. Painted soft shading, variable dark outlines, detailed teal metal panels, warm amber indicator lights, cute rounded cat-inspired industrial design but NO characters and no humans. 3/4 top-down orthographic, top and south front visible, light top left. Wide desk footprint 2 by 1 tiles, reference 128px per tile, desk height 60px, screen tops 140px. Transparent canvas, entire object inside with generous transparent margin, bottom-center ground anchor. Single console only, no floor or room, no words or numbers. Canvas proportions 256 wide by 288 tall.

Orthographic axis-aligned top-down, teal, amber, painted shading; no words or humans.
